scope: the CPU part of a pipeline (layer) split across two pods, on one host and in process: the tiny seeded 4-layer dense decoder split at layer 2, activation frames of the F32 boundary crossing the real PodWire request frame codec as signed chunks into a receiving assembler (allowlist, reorder window, per-principal reservations and tombstones, deadlines, replay protection), bit-identity of logits and per-pod KV against the single-pod run, a 16 MiB transport-only frame in five chunks, smuggling probes that try to move a KV page across the wire, and a downstream KV cache that revalidates the upstream stage generation, manifest digest and placement epoch at every use under revocation, supersession and re-placement with the Revoke message normal, dropped, delayed and in flight
limitations: the code under test is the CPU reference path on a tiny seeded model: bit-identity checks the plumbing (the stage hand-over, framing, reassembly), not the math, because the layer code is shared by the split and the single-pod run; no real checkpoint, no GPU, no other dtype than F32
frames cross the real PodWire request frame codec in process: no socket, no iroh transport, no second host, no latency or throughput claim (E008)

the chunk envelope is authenticated with an Ed25519 signature of the upstream runtime registered per authenticated principal; key distribution, rotation and the binding of the principal to a connection are not modelled
the time is a virtual clock the harness advances; clock skew is a tolerance, not a simulated drift

a completed frame holds one of 64 table slots per principal until its signed deadline plus the skew bound, so one principal sustains at most 64 / (deadline budget + skew) frames per second; the cases stay inside that bound by signing deadlines 100 ms ahead

the extensions of the design (input lineage and raw ancestry, Approximate frames and taint, persistence rejection, the expert, adapter, base-model, semantic, memory and derived kinds of the invalidation matrix) are E008's; the restore path does not apply because no KV is restored on a Pod
synthetic seeded token sequences; one process, one machine profile
